newsitem.title: USA: Devcon loses contract suit, see Q2 charge.
newsitem.headline: Devcon loses contract suit, see Q2 charge.

text.p: Devcon International Corp said Friday a Florida court had ordered it to pay $2 million to a subcontractor in a breach-of-contract suit. It said it would appeal the decision.
Devcon said it intends to establish a reserve in the approximate amount of the ruling or any judgment. It said the reserve would adversely impact operating results for the second quarter.
The Orange County court ruling established $2 millio in liability and damages, and ordered Devcon to pay interest on $1.4 million of the total accrued since February 1992.
The litigation involved construction of a golf course. Devcon did not name the subcontractor.

"We believe that Devcon acted properly in its dealings with the subcontractor, and we intend to exhaust all efforts to challenge this ruling, including seeking reconsideration and appeals," Devcon said in a statement.
Devcon produces and distributes ready-mix concrete, crushed stone, concrete block and asphalt, and distributes bulk and bagged cement in the eastern Caribbean.
